(1) LM-18 is a row this episode DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED -- fact_recheck.v001.md section 6 lists it under rows excluded because the film does not characterise the victims, forbidden_claim -05. (2) LM-18 is SECONDARY, sourced to The Canadian Encyclopedia for corroboration only, and the ledger header states a SECONDARY row may not carry a load-bearing beat. (3) "This film states the figure once" is simply false -- the narration says it FIVE times, at script.en.v001.md lines 20, 243, 358, 382 and 472 -- and it is a production note that leaked onto the screen. Only "47 people died" (LM-16) is supported, so that is all the card now says.

figures._correction_20260901: WAS: "...Nothing here is dramatised. The record is enough." The film cannot say that. 221 of its 355 cuts are generated clips from motion/, and THIRTY SECONDS AFTER THIS CARD, at 12:02-12:17, three of them show a person reaching into a ruptured tank car, a figure approaching the same rupture, and a person climbing over a derailed tank car. Those are dramatisations, and one of them puts a person in the frame at the wreck, which is the very thing the second sentence promises. A disclosure that is contradicted by the next shot is worse than no disclosure. The card now states what is actually true and keeps the promise it can keep.
